1. (Currently Amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __with a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, and a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

2. (Currently Amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __said first forward corner including a first section of said open rib structure with said first fore-aft rib and said first plurality of transverse ribs, and said second forward corner including a second section of said open rib structure with said second fore-aft rib and said second plurality of transverse ribs__.
